description: Tổng giá trị giao dịch toàn bộ cổ phiếu trong ngành ngày t (TotalValue_Sector)

source_entity: Security Trading Snapshot / Listed Share Info

description: Chỉ số căng thẳng ngành tổng hợp — weighted average StressScore theo tỷ trọng vốn hóa (StressScoreSector)
etl_logic: SUM(((risk_weight_config.weight WHERE risk_weight_config.risk_factor_code = 'W1_DRAWDOWN' AND risk_weight_config.risk_factor_type = 'Chỉ số áp lực ngành' AND risk_weight_config.data_dt = MAX(data_dt) <= security_trading_snapshot.trading_dt) * Pdrawdown + (risk_weight_config.weight WHERE risk_weight_config.risk_factor_code = 'W2_VOLATILITY' AND risk_weight_config.risk_factor_type = 'Chỉ số áp lực ngành' AND risk_weight_config.data_dt = MAX(data_dt) <= security_trading_snapshot.trading_dt) * Pvolatility + (risk_weight_config.weight WHERE risk_weight_config.risk_factor_code = 'W3_SELLING' AND risk_weight_config.risk_factor_type = 'Chỉ số áp lực ngành' AND risk_weight_config.data_dt = MAX(data_dt) <= security_trading_snapshot.trading_dt) * (Pselling * 100)) * ((security_trading_snapshot.close_price * listed_share_info.outstanding_share_quantity) / NULLIF((SUM(security_trading_snapshot.close_price * listed_share_info.outstanding_share_quantity) JOIN security_trading_snapshot.symbol = securities_trade.security_symbol_code AND security_trading_snapshot.trading_dt = securities_trade.trade_dt LEFT JOIN listed_share_info ON listed_share_info.ticker_symbol = security_trading_snapshot.symbol AND listed_share_info.src_stm_code = 'VSDC_OUTSTANDING_SHARES' AND listed_share_info.ds_snpst_dt = (SELECT MAX(sc2.ds_snpst_dt) FROM listed_share_info sc2 WHERE sc2.ticker_symbol = security_trading_snapshot.symbol AND sc2.src_stm_code = 'VSDC_OUTSTANDING_SHARES' AND sc2.ds_snpst_dt <= security_trading_snapshot.trading_dt) GROUP BY public_company.business_line_level_1_code, security_trading_snapshot.trading_dt), 0))) LEFT JOIN listed_share_info ON listed_share_info.ticker_symbol = security_trading_snapshot.symbol AND listed_share_info.src_stm_code = 'VSDC_OUTSTANDING_SHARES' AND listed_share_info.ds_snpst_dt = (SELECT MAX(sc2.ds_snpst_dt) FROM listed_share_info sc2 WHERE sc2.ticker_symbol = security_trading_snapshot.symbol AND sc2.src_stm_code = 'VSDC_OUTSTANDING_SHARES' AND sc2.ds_snpst_dt <= security_trading_snapshot.trading_dt) JOIN security_trading_snapshot.symbol = securities_trade.security_symbol_code AND security_trading_snapshot.trading_dt = securities_trade.trade_dt GROUP BY public_company.business_line_level_1_code, security_trading_snapshot.trading_dt, trong do Pdrawdown = (MAX(security_trading_snapshot.close_price) OVER (PARTITION BY security_trading_snapshot.symbol ORDER BY security_trading_snapshot.trading_dt ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) - security_trading_snapshot.close_price) / NULLIF(MAX(security_trading_snapshot.close_price) OVER (PARTITION BY security_trading_snapshot.symbol ORDER BY security_trading_snapshot.trading_dt ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 0) * 100 WHERE security_trading_snapshot.floor_code IN ('02','04','10'); Pvolatility = (Sigma_i - Sigma_min) / NULLIF(Sigma_max - Sigma_min, 0) * 100, trong do Sigma_i = STDDEV_SAMP(LN(security_trading_snapshot.close_price / LAG(security_trading_snapshot.close_price) OVER (PARTITION BY security_trading_snapshot.symbol ORDER BY security_trading_snapshot.trading_dt))) OVER (PARTITION BY security_trading_snapshot.symbol ORDER BY security_trading_snapshot.trading_dt ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) (per ma CK); Sigma_min/Sigma_max = MIN/MAX(Sigma_i) GROUP BY security_trading_snapshot.trading_dt (toan thi truong cung ngay) - tat ca tinh tren security_trading_snapshot WHERE floor_code IN ('02','04','10'); Pselling = (SUM(daily_sell_vol) OVER (PARTITION BY security_match_log.symbol ORDER BY security_match_log.trading_dt ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), trong do daily_sell_vol = SUM(security_match_log.match_vol) GROUP BY security_match_log.symbol, security_match_log.trading_dt WHERE security_match_log.trade_direction_code='S') / NULLIF(SUM(securities_trade.execution_vol) OVER (PARTITION BY securities_trade.security_symbol_code ORDER BY securities_trade.trade_dt ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) WHERE securities_trade.market_id_code IN ('STO','STX','UPX'), 0)
source_entity: Security Trading Snapshot / Securities Trade / Risk Weight Configuration
